name: VLRT Bounty (Very Low Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate a very low risk criminal target. These bounties typically involve new criminals with minor infractions and minimal combat capability. Suitable for novice bounty hunters flying starter ships.

name: LRT Bounty (Low Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate a low risk criminal target. Targets are typically flying light fighters or small utility ships. Requires basic combat proficiency and a capable light fighter.

name: MRT Bounty (Medium Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate a medium risk criminal target. These criminals fly medium fighters or gunships and often travel with an escort. Requires a well-equipped fighter and decent combat experience.

name: HRT Bounty (High Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate a high risk criminal target. Targets fly heavy fighters or medium combat ships and are typically well-armed and escorted. Requires significant combat skill and a heavy fighter or medium ship.

name: VHRT Bounty (Very High Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate a very high risk criminal target. These are hardened criminals piloting heavy combat ships with multiple escorts. Requires advanced combat skills and a heavy fighter or gunship.

name: ERT Bounty (Extreme Risk Target)
description: Track and eliminate an extreme risk criminal target. These targets pilot capital-class ships and are protected by extensive escort wings. The most dangerous and lucrative bounty hunter contracts available. Requires a multi-crew ship and coordinated team.

name: Bunker Clearance Operation
description: Respond to hostile takeover of a defensive bunker. Clear the facility of hostile forces, neutralize all threats, and secure the site for the contracting faction. Requires FPS combat proficiency and appropriate ground equipment.

name: Site Defense Contract
description: Defend a facility or outpost against waves of hostile attackers. Hold the position until reinforcements arrive or the threat is eliminated. Requires sustained combat capability and defensive positioning.

name: Personnel Evacuation
description: Extract civilian or military personnel from a hostile zone. Navigate to the extraction point, protect evacuees, and transport them to safety. Requires ground combat skills and a ship with passenger capacity.

name: Ground Assault Operation
description: Lead an assault on a fortified enemy position. Eliminate all resistance and destroy key assets. High-risk mission requiring coordinated ground combat and potentially vehicle support.

name: Standard Package Delivery
description: Transport a package from one location to another within the Stanton system. Simple point-to-point delivery requiring a ship with cargo capacity. Timely delivery increases rewards.

name: Multi-Stop Package Run
description: Transport multiple packages across several stops in the Stanton system. Requires efficient route planning and a ship with sufficient cargo space. Each package has its own delivery deadline.

name: Priority Express Cargo
description: High-priority time-sensitive delivery contract. These packages require expedited handling and have strict delivery windows. Higher pay for the increased time pressure.

name: Cargo Transport Contract
description: Transport bulk cargo between stations and planets. Requires a ship with significant cargo capacity. Cargo may be legal or illicit depending on the shipper. Watch for pirate activity along trade routes.

name: System Supply Run
description: Resupply outposts and stations throughout the Stanton system. Transport essential goods such as food, medical supplies, and equipment to remote locations. Reliable suppliers are always in demand.

name: Risky Cargo Run
description: Transport sensitive or valuable cargo through high-risk areas. May involve illegal goods or items that attract pirate attention. High risk of interdiction but significantly higher pay.

name: Mining Claim Assessment
description: Travel to a designated asteroid belt or planetary surface to assess mineral deposits. Use a Prospector or Mole to survey and extract valuable ores. Process raw materials and deliver refined goods.

name: Salvage Operation
description: Locate and salvage wrecked ships and debris fields. Use a Vulture or Reclaimer to strip valuable materials from derelict vessels. Can be legally contracted or operated independently.

name: Salvage Claim Contract
description: Claims on specific wreckage sites with known valuable salvage. These are exclusive contracts that guarantee rights to a particular salvage location. Payout depends on the quality and quantity of salvageable materials.

name: Medical Rescue Transport
description: Respond to medical emergencies and transport patients to medical facilities. Requires a ship with medical beds (C8R Pisces, Cutlass Red, Apollo, or similar). Time-critical response needed.

name: Search and Recovery
description: Locate missing individuals in dangerous areas and extract them for medical treatment. May involve navigating hostile territory or environmental hazards. Requires both search capability and medical transport.

name: Missing Persons Investigation
description: Investigate the disappearance of an individual. Search locations for clues, follow leads, and determine the fate of the missing person. May involve exploration of remote wrecks or abandoned facilities.

name: Derelict Ship Investigation
description: Board and investigate a derelict vessel adrift in space. Determine the cause of the incident, recover black box data, and report findings. Beware of potential hazards including environmental dangers, booby traps, or hostile occupants.

name: Illicit Cargo Transport
description: Transport illegal or restricted goods through Stanton system undetected. Avoid scan checks at security stations and deliver contraband to clandestine locations. High profit but serious legal consequences if caught.

name: Piracy Interdiction
description: Interdict and disable civilian or cargo vessels to steal their cargo. Requires electronic warfare capabilities and disabling weapons. Work with a crew to secure cargo and escape before security arrives.

name: Ship Repair Service
description: Provide repair services to damaged ships in the field. Use repair tools or specialized repair ships to restore hull integrity, fix components, and restore ship functionality. Essential for deep-space operations.

name: Refueling Operation
description: Provide fuel to stranded ships in deep space. Requires a Starfarer or similar refueling vessel. Critical service for explorers and long-haul cargo operators pushing beyond standard refueling stations.
